positions.title: Jr. Director of Virtualization/System Administrator
positions.description:
Solution owner of a multi-datacenter, VMware based public cloud infrastructure. Also responsible for managing multiple internal VMware production/development systems and a small team. Duties are wide-ranging, but include:

• Plan, test, and implement major upgrades of all production VMware virtual infrastructure components
• Architect, deploy, and manage a highly available vRealize Automation platform utilizing F5 load balancing
• Automate VMware environment with custom PowerShell/PowerCLI scripting
• Research and implement Proof-of-Concept platforms to improve virtualization product suite 
• Provide tier 3 technical support for clients

positions.title: Network Operations Engineer (Lead)
positions.description:
• Provide tier 1/2 technical support for clients through phone, email, ticket, and on-floor support
• Maintain and improve datacenter infrastructure
• Build, install, and configure servers
• Rack servers, switch-gear, and network cabling

positions.title: Reports Coordinator
positions.description:
In addition to the regular job duties below, spent time streamlining the reporting process by developing macros and templates that automated and standardized reports whenever possible.

• Compile, produce, and distribute various reports from multiple databases
• Assist Project Manager, Network Managers and Vice-President in tracking recruiter activity, including client specific reports that capture campaign details
• Coordinate projects, prioritize, and provide status of assignments to Management

positions.title: Database Manager/Telephone Recruiter
positions.description:
Responsible for administration and design enhancements for a market research Microsoft Access database. Learned advanced Excel formulas and formatting to quickly process and import considerable data backlogs. 

Began as a telephone recruiter, but was cross-promoted due to work ethic and demonstration of technical aptitude.
